summary: Completed testing of PROGRAMADO features in SMS Seguimiento view. All 5 requested features are working correctly: 1) SUMA PROGRAMADO displayed alongside META, 2) Edit modal shows meta global, suma, and disponible, 3) Validation prevents exceeding meta, 4) Backend endpoint returns correct sum, 5) Can save PROGRAMADO within limits.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data in PostgreSQL database
